title: Writing quality
workflow: Draft → Language → Logic → Literary review → Author revisions
optional: Every step is optional. Manuscripts, Canon and final status are never changed automatically.
localNotice: Offline checks only a few layout issues; it does not guess spelling or reject valid dialogue.
queryHint: Character, item, injury or knowledge keywords
related: Related chapter sources (optional, up to twelve)
coverageNotice: Retrieve candidates, then verify current excerpts; unselected content is not reviewed.
historySaved: A pre-edit revision is saved in revision history.
noFindings: No candidates in the checked scope; this is not proof of an error-free manuscript.
dictionaryNotice: Reuse character and world names. One custom term per line. Terms do not establish story facts.
mathNotice: Textual logic findings are hypotheses. Confirm formal assumptions and solve in the existing World Logic Lab.
experiment: Design verification in World Logic Lab
experimentSeed: Design an editable experiment from these verified excerpts. Keep missing inputs unknown, confirm formalization and acceptance first; no Canon changes:
